name: [UPD 2] 🌑 Sea Piece
desc:
🌊 Welcome to Sea Piece 🌊
Start your adventure, and conquer the One Piece!

❗ 50000 LIKES FOR NEXT CODE ❗ 

🎮 Controls:
Q - Dash
Double Space - Geppo
Ctrl - Sprint
H - Buso Haki
J - Ken Haki
K - Conquerers Haki
Z/X/C/R/T - Skills
G - Race* ability (Some don't have any)

❗ Information:
Fruits spawn around the map every hour and despawn after 30 minutes.
You can buy fruits from the fruit dealer, or take a chance at the fruit gacha.

Join the DS for more Codes and information!

9z4eckNPxD

Level cap: 1500

🎮 PC AND MOBILE COMPATIBLE 🎮
